cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can settle your apology for missing my birthday. Give me first choice of a Christmas visit and I'll put the hurt behind us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum already has Christmas Day. I can't promise you that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boxing Day will suit my plan nicely. You choose the train; I'll tell Mum we're all right again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather you actually felt all right than just told her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the whole weekend, and I'll work on feeling it. You can choose what we do; in return, I won't bring the birthday up while you're here.
